about.p1: Hotel Rutherbach is idyllically situated right on the Ruhr in Essen-Kettwig. For many years we have welcomed guests from all over the world, offering them a relaxing stay in a family atmosphere.
about.p2: Our house combines the benefits of a quiet location in the Ruhr valley with proximity to the historic town centre of Kettwig. Whether you are travelling on business or on holiday – you will find the perfect accommodation with us.
about.p3: Each of our rooms is individually furnished and offers you all the amenities for a comfortable stay. Start your day with a generous breakfast buffet and enjoy the view of the Ruhr.

s1.title: 1. Data protection at a glance
s1.subtitle: General information
s1.text: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to identify you personally.

s3.title: 3. Data collection on this website
s3.contactFormP1: If you send us enquiries via the contact form, the information you provide in the enquiry form, including the contact details you enter there, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the enquiry and in the event of follow-up questions. We will not pass on this data without your consent.
s3.contactFormP2: This data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 (1) lit. b GDPR, insofar as your enquiry is related to the performance of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures.
s3.cookiesP1: Our website uses cookies. These are small text files that your web browser stores on your device. Cookies help us to make our website more user-friendly, effective and secure.
s3.cookiesP2: Some cookies are technically necessary for certain functions of the website to work (essential). Other cookies are only set with your explicit consent (statistics, marketing).
s3.cookiesP3: You can change your cookie settings at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of this page.

s4.title: 4. Your rights
s4.intro: You have the right at any time to:
rights: Erasure of your data (right to be forgotten)
s4.outro: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the contact details provided above.

s5.title: 5. Duration of data storage
s5.text: We only store your personal data for as long as is necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by statutory retention periods.

s6.title: 6. Right to lodge a complaint
s6.text: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The competent supervisory authority for data protection matters is the State Data Protection Commissioner of the Federal Republic of Germany.

s7.title: 7. Changes to this privacy policy
s7.text: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to reflect changes to our services in the privacy policy.
